extracted.intended_audience: state environmental agency officials, ECOS members, and program staff working on environmental justice and Title VI
extracted.subtask_description: A compilation of frameworks, policies, and procedural guidance for state environmental agencies and their staff to implement Environmental Justice (EJ) and Title VI civil rights compliance across permitting, grants, complaints, and program operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Permitting Risk Management Framework (permitting risk-based actions)
rubrics_metrics.description: This Risk Management Framework presents strategies to assist ECOS members in understanding state compliance with civil rights laws and Title VI as they relate to environmental permitting, recognizing potential risks of both civil rights violations and industry litigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Framework identifies key actions across five subject areas, assigning them risk values based on an assessment of U.S. EPA publications and state experience. It is intended to help states prioritize actions to reduce risk of civil rights violations in permitting decisions and to anticipate litigation risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: ECOS Environmental Justice and External Civil Rights Vision, Principles & Priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: A vision document serving as a guide for ECOS EJ and Title VI work, informed by input from ECOS members and led by the EJ Steering Committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priorities include compiling state and federal best practices, coordinating with U.S. EPA, and convening states to inform policy decisions across federal partners. The document is meant to propel ECOS EJ Workgroup activities and policy direction.

rubrics_metrics.name: ECOS EJ Workgroup objectives (sharing, tools, EPA dialogue)
rubrics_metrics.description: The goals of the workgroup include sharing ideas and experiences in implementing EJ efforts, discussing tools and approaches that would assist states in addressing EJ concerns, and conducting a dialogue with EPA to identify areas where states and EPA can partner to facilitate these efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workgroup composition: state environmental agency commissioners, deputies, and EJ directors/coordinators from more than 35 states. The group meets as needed and is open to all ECOS members and staff; it functions as a venue for exchanging practical programmatic approaches and coordinating with EPA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 4700-4 pre-award review process (four-corners / on its face) and form completion
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. EPA's Office of Environmental Justice and External Civil Rights provides an overview of the pre-award EPA Form 4700-4 review process, including applicant certification and the new 'four-corners' or 'on its face' review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes tips for form completion to satisfy pre-award review requirements. Useful for applicants seeking EPA financial assistance and for state staff supporting applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 4700-4 post-award auditing processes (recipient selection, RFIs, resolutions)
rubrics_metrics.description: OEJECR discusses post-award auditing processes, including recipient selection, requests for information (RFIs), and resolutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides states and recipients on expectations after award: how audits may be selected and carried out, what information may be requested, and common resolution pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title VI complaint and compliance review processes
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. EPA's Office of Environmental Justice and External Civil Rights explores agency processes for complaints, including acknowledgment of receipt, evaluation, jurisdictional determination, and acceptance for investigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also explains compliance review mechanics: initiation of reviews, notice to recipients, and resolution paths. Useful as a procedural rubric for handling and responding to Title VI complaints and compliance actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form 4700-4 Process Revision Overview (Dec 2022)
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview on the new review process for Form 4700-4, Preaward Compliance Review Report for All Applicants and Recipients Requesting EPA Financial Assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes revisions to preaward compliance review practice and implications for applicants and grant administrators; useful reference when updating internal procedures or applicant guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles for Addressing Environmental Justice Concerns in Air Permitting
rubrics_metrics.description: A framework of principles and practices to assist each EPA region to promote environmental justice and equity through air permitting programs using existing CAA authorities and discretion, federal civil rights laws, as well as other federal and state laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to help regions and states mitigate potential adverse and disproportionate effects of a permitting action. Uses legal authorities and permitting practices to identify and reduce EJ impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Justice Guidance for UIC Class VI Permitting and Primacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Document supporting Class VI UIC Program Directors in identifying, analyzing, and addressing Environmental Justice concerns when implementing and overseeing all UIC permitting and primacy programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides program-specific EJ considerations for underground injection control Class VI permitting and primacy decisions; helpful for program directors assessing community impacts and engagement needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: EPA Legal Tools to Advance EJ: Cumulative Impacts Addendum
rubrics_metrics.description: An addendum building on the discussion of cumulative impacts in EJ Legal Tools, providing further detail and analysis on the Agency’s legal authority to address cumulative impacts affecting communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers legal analysis and options for agencies seeking to consider cumulative impacts in permitting, enforcement, and program decisions; can inform policy and legal strategy to address multiple overlapping exposures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Impacts Research: Recommendations for ORD
rubrics_metrics.description: A report focusing on cumulative impact research recommendations that cut across the National Research Programs and offers recommendations for how ORD can provide management support for such complex research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides research-priority guidance and methodological recommendations for investigating cumulative impacts; useful for designing or evaluating research projects on EJ cumulative effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: OLEM Environmental Justice Action Plan (land pollution/cleanup programs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan highlighting projects, tools, and practices to be applied to various land pollution prevention and cleanup programs, including Superfund, Brownfields, Emergency Response, Solid Waste Management, Corrective Actions under RCRA, and Underground Storage Tanks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as an implementation-focused roadmap for integrating EJ considerations across land remediation and pollution prevention programs; lists concrete projects and tools relevant to program managers.

rubrics_metrics.name: HHS Environmental Justice Index (identification tool)
rubrics_metrics.description: A tool to help public health officials identify areas most at risk of environmental health problems. It was developed by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry, and HHS’s Office of Environmental Justice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for targeting public health and EJ interventions; can be used by state agencies to prioritize outreach, monitoring, and resources to most-impacted communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: ECOS Green Report: State Environmental Justice Highlights (2023)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report exploring state efforts to advance Title VI and Environmental Justice in 2023, and highlighting state presentations and topics examined during ECOS EJ Workgroup meetings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sections cover new state EJ laws and policies, ongoing ECOS coordination with U.S. EPA, emerging state programs, Supplemental Environmental Projects on EJ, and EJ mapping tools. Useful as a benchmarking and best-practices resource.
